units.source_text: 你一定会觉得不可思议吧，这样孤僻的我怎么会有闲心喜欢小姐呢？

en.t: You must find it strange that someone as solitary as I could still have had the leisure to fall in love with the young lady.

units.source_text: 怎么还能有工夫愉快地欣赏她那蹩脚的插花呢？

en.t: How could I also have had time to enjoy admiring her clumsy flower arrangements?

units.source_text: 怎么还会有心情倾听她那单调的琴声呢？

en.t: How could I still have had the heart to listen to the monotonous sound of her koto?

units.source_text: 你若是这样问的话，我只能说这两方面都是事实。

en.t: If you ask me that, I can only say that both sides were true.

units.source_text: 除了把事实告诉你之外，我没有别的办法。

en.t: I have no way other than to tell you the facts as they were.

units.source_text: 你是个有头脑的人，随你怎么去想。

en.t: You are an intelligent person, so I leave it to you to think of it as you will.

units.source_text: 我在这里只想补充一句话：尽管在金钱上我怀疑人性，但在爱情方面却不怀疑人性。

en.t: I only want to add one thing here: although I doubted human nature where money was concerned, I did not doubt it where love was concerned.

units.source_text: 即便别人无法理解，自己也觉得自相矛盾，它们却在我胸中和平共处着。

en.t: Even if others could not understand it, and even if I myself felt it was contradictory, those things coexisted peacefully within my breast.
